addition.item: First release. Full-page age gate for Joomla sites with content reserved for adults, built in the browser so cached pages stay valid. Works on Joomla 4.4, 5 and 6, with or without YOOtheme.

Every visible text comes from the Joomla language files (PLG_SYSTEM_WEBGCONSENT_*, English and Italian) and can be changed with System, Language Overrides. Per-language texts in the plugin settings are optional: an empty field uses the language file.
Pseudonymous consent register (random visitor ID, HMAC of the IP, never the IP in clear) with rate limit, 730 days retention and CSV export from the back end.

security.item: Signed short-lived token for the log endpoint, rate limits per IP and global, export only for super users, no DDL from public requests.
